title: Detailed tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="42" ry="6" fill="#2a3a4a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Rear wheel (large) -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="20" fill="#1a2a3a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="18" fill="#3a5a7a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="14" fill="#2a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="10" fill="#4a7a9a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="5" fill="#7ab0d0"/>
  <!-- Rear wheel treads -->
  <rect x="29" y="48" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa"/>
  <rect x="29" y="83" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa"/>
  <rect x="10" y="67" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa"/>
  <rect x="45" y="67" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa"/>
  <rect x="15" y="52" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa" transform="rotate(-30 16 54)"/>
  <rect x="41" y="52" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa" transform="rotate(30 42 54)"/>
  <rect x="15" y="79" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa" transform="rotate(30 16 81)"/>
  <rect x="41" y="79" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#5a8aaa" transform="rotate(-30 42 81)"/>

  <!-- Front wheel (smaller) -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="12" fill="#1a2a3a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="10" fill="#3a5a7a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="7" fill="#2a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="4" fill="#4a7a9a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="2" fill="#7ab0d0"/>

  <!-- Front axle -->
  <rect x="68" y="72" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#6a6a7a"/>

  <!-- Tractor body main -->
  <rect x="22" y="48" width="56" height="20" rx="4" fill="#e8a020"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <rect x="24" y="50" width="52" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f0c050"/>

  <!-- Engine hood -->
  <rect x="56" y="44" width="22" height="18" rx="3" fill="#d08010"/>
  <rect x="58" y="46" width="18" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f0b030"/>
  <!-- Hood detail lines -->
  <rect x="60" y="52" width="14" height="2" rx="1" fill="#b06008"/>
  <rect x="60" y="56" width="14" height="2" rx="1" fill="#b06008"/>

  <!-- Grill -->
  <rect x="76" y="50" width="4" height="12" rx="1" fill="#c07010"/>
  <rect x="77" y="52" width="2" height="2" fill="#f0d060"/>
  <rect x="77" y="56" width="2" height="2" fill="#f0d060"/>
  <rect x="77" y="60" width="2" height="2" fill="#f0d060"/>

  <!-- Cab / windshield -->
  <rect x="28" y="30" width="24" height="20" rx="3" fill="#d08010"/>
  <rect x="30" y="32" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="#6ab8e8"/>
  <!-- Windshield reflection -->
  <rect x="32" y="34" width="6" height="10" rx="1" fill="#9ad8f8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Cab roof -->
  <rect x="26" y="28" width="28" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f0c050"/>
  <!-- Cab pillar side -->
  <rect x="28" y="30" width="3" height="20" rx="1" fill="#b06a08"/>

  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="48" y="22" width="4" height="16" rx="2" fill="#8a8a9a"/>
  <rect x="47" y="20" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#6a6a7a"/>
  <!-- Exhaust smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="3" fill="#8ab8d0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="11" r="2.5" fill="#8ab8d0" opacity="0.4"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="7" r="2" fill="#8ab8d0" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Steering wheel -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="38" rx="6" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#4a3a2a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="35" y="38" width="2" height="10" fill="#4a3a2a"/>

  <!-- Fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d="M12 64 Q12 46 30 46 Q48 46 48 64" fill="none" stroke="#d08010" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Rear lights -->
  <rect x="22" y="58" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#e04040"/>
  <rect x="22" y="64" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#40e040"/>

  <!-- Step -->
  <rect x="50" y="66" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#6a6a7a"/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="57" r="3" fill="#f0e060"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="57" r="4" fill="#f0e060" opacity="0.3"/>

  <!-- Hitch at back -->
  <rect x="16" y="62" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#8a8a9a"/>
</svg>
